The difference-in-differences estimate of the ATT is -27.35 packs per capita. Proposition 99 reduced cigarette sales.

I regressed `cigsale` on `california`, `after_treatment` and their interaction, using only those three variables as instructed. The interaction coefficient is the ATT.

| Group | Before | After | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Other states | 130.57 | 102.06 | -28.51 |
| California | 116.21 | 60.35 | -55.86 |

The ATT is California's change minus the other states' change: -55.86 − (−28.51) = −27.35.

ANSWER: -27.35
